page.content:
He fights in the battle against the Feudalism. He can also be seen at Moe's. He along with a few others are seen to survive the battle. He also didn't disappear since he was a human.

page.overview:
Who is Barney Gumble?

He fights in the battle against the Feudalism. He can also be seen at Moe's. He along with a few others are seen to survive the battle. He also didn't disappear since he was a human.
